GET /v1/groups.description: A user group is a named set of roles. A right given to a group is held by everyone whose role is in it, on top of what their role allows. A person still has exactly one role.
GET /v1/groups.access: a role with Roles: View roles

groups.name: string
roles: string. Role keys in the group
groups.count: integer. People whose role is in the group

POST /v1/groups.access: a role with Roles: Manage roles & rights

request.name: string, required. Up to 60 characters
roles: string. Role keys to put in the group

errors.400: Name missing or too long, or a role does not exist
errors.409: name_taken; locked_role: that role already has every right so it does not need a group

GET /v1/groups/{key}.summary: Get a group and its rights
GET /v1/groups/{key}.access: a role with Roles: View roles

response.name: string
roles: string. Role keys in the group
response.count: integer. People whose role is in the group

<module>.<right>: boolean. Whether the group holds it

PATCH /v1/groups/{key}.description: Send `roles` to replace its members; leave it out to keep them.
PATCH /v1/groups/{key}.access: a role with Roles: Manage roles & rights

request.name: string
roles: string. Role keys; omit to leave as it is

DELETE /v1/groups/{key}.description: Its members keep their roles; the rights given through the group are removed.
DELETE /v1/groups/{key}.access: a role with Roles: Manage roles & rights

PUT /v1/groups/{key}/rights.summary: Allow or deny a right for a group
PUT /v1/groups/{key}/rights.description: May need approval (flow f8): 200 applied, 202 an approval request was raised.
PUT /v1/groups/{key}/rights.access: a role with Roles: Manage roles & rights

response.request: object. The approval request when one was raised

errors.409: gone: that group or right no longer exists
